prompt: I need to move data from the Community Health Toolkit (CHT) to SatuSehat Platform: pull the newest report, leave the fields unchanged, and post it to SatuSehat Platform as a questionnaire response.
workflow_yaml:
name: dry-run
jobs:
  fetch:
    name: Fetch record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-cht@latest'
    body: |
      get('/api/v2/export/reports', { query: { filters: {} } });
  post:
    name: Post record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-satusehat@latest'
    body: |
      fn(state => {
        const r = state.data[0];
        state.qr = { resourceType: 'QuestionnaireResponse', status: 'completed', questionnaire: r.form,
          authored: new Date(r.reported_date).toISOString(),
          item: Object.entries(r.fields || {}).map(([k, v]) => ({ linkId: k, answer: [{ valueString: String(v) }] })) };
        return state;
      });
      post('QuestionnaireResponse', state => state.qr);
triggers:
  webhook:
    type: webhook
edges:
  webhook->fetch:
    source_trigger: webhook
    target_job: fetch
  fetch->post:
    source_job: fetch
    target_job: post
    condition_type: on_job_success
